steps.objective: Armin is sitting by the canal. Go see if he's all right
Find Eren and Mikasa by the gate

complete.deed: Spent the last quiet morning of 845 with Eren, Mikasa and Armin

steps.objective: Head home along the main street

say.text: Lightning, out of a clear sky. Then a hand, skinless and steaming, grips the top of the Wall.

steps.objective: Look toward the outer gate

say.text: The gate blows apart. Rocks come down all over the district.

steps.objective: Eren is running for his house. Follow him

say.text: The house has come down. Carla is pinned under the main beam.

steps.objective: Help Carla
Go with Hannes. Don't look back

say.text: A titan turns into your street. It's smiling.
Behind you, Eren is screaming for his mother. Hannes doesn't stop running.

steps.objective: There's a titan on the road to the boats. Bring it down

say.text: It's between us and the gate. You've got blades? Go for the back of the neck. Only the neck.

steps.objective: Everyone is fleeing to the inner gate. Get there

say.text: Everyone to the inner gate! The boats won't wait!
The crowd is packed so tight you can barely move. Somewhere in it, someone is calling your name.

steps.objective: Find Armin in the crowd

complete.deed: Escaped Shiganshina as Wall Maria fell

steps.objective: Find Armin in the refugee camp
Refugees from Shiganshina are arriving at the inner gate. Go and see
Talk to the Garrison captain on the dock
Check on the girl sitting by the crates

complete.deed: Met the refugees from Shiganshina at Trost's gate

steps.objective: Take Lotte to the market to find her something to eat
Take a loaf from the crate without being seen (crouch, stay out of their line of sight)

done.deed: Stole bread for a hungry refugee girl

say.text: ...Thank you.

steps.objective: Your father is arguing with a Military Police officer
A Garrison rider is reading names in the square. Find your father

say.text: A Garrison rider comes through the village reading from a list.

steps.objective: Walk with him to the edge of the village

say.text: Around a hundred people came back from the Reclamation. He wasn't one of them.

missions.title: The Pleasant Side of the Wall

steps.objective: Something's going on at a bakery stall in the market
A pastor of the Church of the Walls is preaching nearby
A well-dressed man is waving you over

complete.deed: Saw how peace is kept in the interior

missions.title: The Pleasant Side of the Wall

steps.objective: Something's going on at a bakery stall in the market
A pastor of the Church of the Walls is preaching nearby
A well-dressed man is waving you over

complete.deed: Saw how peace is kept in the interior

steps.objective: Ferrin the smuggler wants to see you
Take the gear from the MP post without being seen (crouch, stay out of their line of sight)

done.deed: Stole ODM gear from the Military Police

say.text: Told you it'd be easy.

steps.objective: Head for the stairway to the surface
Slip past the guard while he's not looking

complete.deed: Saw the sky for the first time in years

steps.objective: Report to the Cadet Training Camp
Fall in for Instructor Shadis's inspection
Find Sasha after dark
Put on your ODM harness for the aptitude test (open your inventory with E and wear it)
Eren is having trouble on the balance rig
Annie is training on her own by the fence
Reiner and Bertholdt are by the barracks
Head out to the training forest
Cut the napes of the training titans

say.text: Most kills gets the top score. Try to keep up.

steps.objective: Jean and Marco are catching their breath
It's graduation day. Fall in

missions.title: The Colossal Returns
missions.chapter: Act I · The Battle of Trost, 850

steps.objective: Report to your squad near Trost's outer gate
Talk to Eren
Brace yourself

say.text: That's him. That's the one from five years ago.
The outer gate caves in. Rocks come down across the whole district.

steps.objective: Titans are coming through the gate. Stop them
A titan has Thomas! Kill it before it's too late

say.text: You came back for me...
THOMAS!
It's got Thomas!

missions.title: Evacuation
missions.chapter: Act I · The Battle of Trost, 850

steps.objective: People are trapped at the inner gate
Hold them off while everyone gets through

complete.deed: Held the inner gate while Trost was evacuated

missions.title: The Supply Depot
missions.chapter: Act I · The Battle of Trost, 850

steps.objective: You're almost out of gas. Get to the supply building

say.text: They're all over the supply building. We're out of gas and they're just sitting in there!

steps.objective: Clear the titans out of the supply building
Find Armin

missions.title: The Rogue Titan
missions.chapter: Act I · The Battle of Trost, 850

steps.objective: Find the titan that's fighting the others

say.text: It roars and tears into another titan with its bare hands.

steps.objective: Watch

say.text: Steam pours off its neck. There's someone inside it.

steps.objective: Mikasa is up on the roof
Marco hasn't come back. Check the rooftops near the supply building, quickly

say.text: I'm okay. Reiner, Annie and Bertholdt were just here. They were acting really strange.

success.deed: Found Marco alive, and three friends acting strangely

say.text: Marco is lying in the street. Half of him. Nobody saw what happened.

fail.deed: Found Marco's body. Nobody saw what happened

missions.title: I Thought the Enemy Was Titans

steps.objective: The Survey Corps is recruiting in the square

card.title: Act I: The Walls
card.sub: I thought the enemy was titans.

a.speaker: armin_child
a.text: Oh. Hi, {first}. You didn't see any of that, right?

b.speaker: armin_child
b.text: They took my book. Well, they tried. Grandpa says I'm not supposed to show it to anyone anyway.

b2.speaker: armin_child
b2.text: It's about the outside. There's a lake of salt water out there. So big you can't see the other side.

choices.text: You'll get in real trouble talking like that.
Salt water? Can I see the book?
Which ones took it? Point them out.

c1.speaker: armin_child
c1.text: I know. Everyone says that. I just think it's weird that nobody even wants to look.

c2.speaker: armin_child
c2.text: Here, look at this page. We should go and see it one day. You, me, Eren and Mikasa.

c3.speaker: armin_child
c3.text: It's fine. Eren went after them. Then Mikasa went after Eren, so. They ran pretty fast.

a.speaker: hannes
a.text: Well, if it isn't the little troublemakers. Relax, relax. We're on duty. Technically.

b.speaker: eren_child
b.text: You're drinking on duty! What happens if they come over the Wall?

b2.speaker: hannes
b2.text: Then we'll deal with it. It's been a hundred years, kid. Nothing's getting over that thing.

c.speaker: eren_child
c.text: {first}, you tell him. He doesn't listen to me.

choices.text: Eren's got a point. You don't even look ready.
Leave him alone, Eren. Nothing's going to happen.
Mr. Hannes, what would you actually do if it broke?

d1.speaker: mikasa_child
d1.text: Eren. We need to get the firewood home.

d2.speaker: hannes
d2.text: Ha. Listen to your friend. Now go on, before Carla comes looking for you.

d3.speaker: hannes
d3.text: Honestly? I'd tell you to run for the boats and not stop. Now scram, all of you.

a.speaker: carla
a.text: My legs... I can't feel my legs. Eren, Mikasa, go. Go now.

b.speaker: eren_child
b.text: We're not leaving you! {first}, help me lift it!

choices.text: (Grab the beam and pull with Eren.)
Mikasa, come on. We have to go.
I'll get help!

c1.text: It doesn't move. Not even a little. The ground shakes again, closer.

c3.text: You run into the street and nearly knock Hannes over.

d.speaker: hannes
d.text: Carla! Hold on. Kids, stand back.

e.speaker: carla
e.text: Hannes, don't. You can't fight it. Take them and get out of here. Please.

f.speaker: carla
f.text: Eren. Mikasa. Live. You hear me? You have to live.

a.speaker: armin_child
a.text: Over here! Grandpa's holding us a place. Eren, where's your mom? Where's...

b.speaker: eren_child
b.text: I'm going to kill them. All of them. Every single one.

choices.text: I'll be right there with you.
Eren... that's not going to bring her back.
(Say nothing. Stay next to Mikasa.)

c.text: The crowd carries you through the gate. Nobody talks. Behind you, smoke is rising over Shiganshina.

a.speaker: armin_child
a.text: They called Grandpa up this morning. Him and pretty much every adult in the camp.

b.speaker: armin_child
b.text: They're calling it an operation to take Wall Maria back. But they gave them farming tools, {first}.

choices.text: There isn't enough food. They're getting rid of people.
Maybe they'll actually win some land back.
I'm sorry, Armin.

c.speaker: eren_child
c.text: We're joining the training corps. Next year, as soon as we're old enough. You're coming, right?

choices.text: Yeah. I'm coming.
I'll join. Not for the same reasons as you, though.

a.speaker: garrison_captain
a.text: You, back up. These people just got here from Shiganshina. They've got nothing left.

b.speaker: garrison_captain
b.text: If you're going to stand there, you might as well help.

choices.text: I'll help carry the injured.
I can keep people back from the dock.
What happened down there?

c1.speaker: garrison_captain
c1.text: Good. Start with the girl by the crates. She came off alone.

c2.speaker: garrison_captain
c2.text: Fine. And keep an eye on that girl by the crates. She hasn't moved in an hour.

c3.speaker: garrison_captain
c3.text: The outer gate's gone. That's all I know. Now either help or move.

a.speaker: lotte
a.text: Are there titans here too?

choices.text: No. The Wall here is fine. You're safe.
I don't know. But I'll keep an eye out for you.
Who did you come with?

b.speaker: lotte
b.text: I'm Lotte. Okay. I'll remember you.

c.speaker: lotte
c.text: My mom put me on the boat. She said she'd get on the next one.

c2.text: The captain said the last boat came in an hour ago.

a.speaker: baker
a.text: Twenty for a loaf. Don't look at me like that, flour's gone up four times since the boats came in.

b.speaker: lotte
b.text: It's okay. I'm not that hungry.

choices.text: I'll buy one. [10 Marks, he'll take it]

effects.deed: Bought bread for a hungry refugee girl

choices.text: (Quietly) Wait here. I'll get us some.
They're handing out rations at the square later.

a.speaker: aldo
a.text: They want a third of the harvest. For the refugees, apparently.

b.speaker: tax_collector
b.text: Crown's orders. Everyone inside Wall Rose gives. Unless you'd like to explain to someone in Mitras why you didn't.

choices.text: Take it. People are starving.
A third? We won't make it to spring.
Do the granaries in Mitras give a third too?

c2.speaker: tax_collector
c2.text: Watch your mouth. People get remembered for less.

c3.speaker: tax_collector
c3.text: ...Fine. A quarter. And I'll remember you.

a.speaker: aldo
a.text: My name's on the list. They're sending us to take back Wall Maria.

b.speaker: aldo
b.text: Two hundred and fifty thousand people. Farmers, mostly. They gave us pitchforks.

choices.text: Don't go. I'll hide you in the barn.
Why do they get to decide who dies for the Walls?
Just come back. Okay?

c1.speaker: aldo
c1.text: And then they burn the farm and take you instead. No.

c2.speaker: aldo
c2.text: Somebody always does. Usually it's people like us.

d.speaker: aldo
d.text: If you join the army, don't go hide in the interior. Go where the decisions get made. Make better ones than this.

effects.deed: Watched your father leave for the Reclamation, 846

a.speaker: hilde
a.text: I paid the permit. I paid it last month, I have the paper here.

b.speaker: mp_officer
b.text: Price went up. Lot of refugees to feed these days. Lot of people to keep order for.

choices.text: Yeah. That's just stealing.
Here. That should cover her. [20 Marks]
No, officer.
You might want to ask who my father is first.

d1.speaker: mp_officer
d1.text: Careful. People who talk like that tend to disappear around here.

d2.speaker: mp_officer
d2.text: Well. That's very generous of you.

d4.speaker: mp_officer
d4.text: ...No need for that. We're done here.

a.speaker: priest
a.text: The Walls were given to us by God. Those who doubt them doubt the only thing standing between us and the end.

choices.text: What are they actually made of?
Thank you, Pastor.
One of them just fell, though.

b1.speaker: priest
b1.text: ...That isn't something you need to know. Some things are better left alone.

b3.speaker: priest
b3.text: Maria fell because its people lost their faith. Don't lose yours.

a.speaker: steward
a.text: My employer has an eye for talent. Finish in the top ten at the training corps and there's a Military Police post for you. Here. Inside.

choices.text: I'll think about it. Seriously.
What if I want to go outside the Walls?

b.speaker: steward
b.text: Most people who go outside don't come back to complain about it. Good day.

a.speaker: ferrin
a.text: You want out of here, you need gear. Real ODM gear. The MP keep a set at the post by the market.

b.speaker: ferrin
b.text: Get in, grab it, get out. Two guards. Don't let them see you, and keep your blades put away.

choices.text: What do you get out of it?
Robbing the MP? I'm in.
I'd rather find another way up.

c2.speaker: ferrin
c2.text: That's what I like to hear.

c3.speaker: ferrin
c3.text: Sure. Pay the stair toll then. It's only about three months of wages.

a.speaker: stair_guard
a.text: Surface access is three hundred. You got it or not?

choices.text: Here. [300 Marks]
I report to the training corps tomorrow. Want to explain to Shadis why I'm late?
(Fire your anchors and fly straight past him.)
(Walk off. Come back when he's not looking.)

a.speaker: keith
a.text: You! Who are you? Where are you from? What are you doing here?

choices.text: {name}, sir! Shiganshina! I'm here to kill titans!
{name}, sir! Trost! To protect the people inside the Walls!
{name}, sir! Ragako! So no one else gets sent to die for nothing!
{name}, sir! {origin}! To join the Military Police!
{name}, sir! The Underground! So I never have to go back down there!
{name}, sir! I want to know what's out there!

b.speaker: keith
b.text: Is that so. We'll see if you last the week.

c.text: A few places down the line, a girl is eating a potato. In the middle of the ceremony.

d.speaker: keith
d.text: ...You. What exactly do you think you're doing?

e.speaker: sasha
e.text: It was hot, sir, and it looked so good, and I... do you want half?

a.speaker: sasha
a.text: Hey, you. You didn't laugh when he made me run. Here, I saved you the last bit. I'm Sasha.

choices.text: You keep it. You ran until dark.
Thanks.

b.speaker: sasha
b.text: Okay. We're friends now. That's how it works.

a.speaker: eren
a.text: I can't stay up on the rig. Everyone else can do it. If I fail again tomorrow they'll send me back to the fields.

choices.text: Let me see your belt. Hang on, the buckle's cracked.

effects.deed: Found the broken belt that almost got Eren sent home

choices.text: Keep your weight forward. Try again.
Maybe this isn't for you.

b1.speaker: eren
b1.text: Wait. It's broken? It was broken this whole time?

b3.speaker: eren
b3.text: Say that to me again once I'm in the Survey Corps.

a.speaker: annie
a.text: They don't grade hand-to-hand, so nobody bothers. What do you want?

choices.text: Show me what you're doing.
So why do you bother?

b1.speaker: annie
b1.text: Feet wider. Turn your hip. Your arm's just the end of it. ...Again.

b2.speaker: annie
b2.text: My dad taught me. He said nobody out there is on your side, so you'd better be able to handle yourself.

a.speaker: reiner
a.text: Hey. You did well on the rig today. Where are you from, anyway?

b.speaker: bertholdt
b.text: We're from a village up in the mountains. In Wall Maria. It's... not there anymore.

choices.text: Same as a lot of people here. I'm sorry.
Which village? I didn't know there were any up there.

c.speaker: reiner
c.text: We're soldiers now. That's what matters.

c2.speaker: reiner
c2.text: Small place. You wouldn't have heard of it.

a.speaker: jean
a.text: Not bad. Top ten get the Military Police, you know. Inside Wall Sina. Real beds. No titans.

choices.text: You can have it. I'm going outside.
Honestly, that doesn't sound bad.
Isn't it weird that the best soldiers get sent furthest from the titans?

b.speaker: marco
b.text: I want to serve the King. I know how that sounds. I mean it, though.

choices.text: You'd be good at it.
Just make sure they deserve you.

c.speaker: jean
c.text: He's too honest. It's going to get him in trouble.

a.speaker: keith
a.text: Top ten. Mikasa Ackerman. Reiner Braun. Bertholdt Hoover. Annie Leonhart. Eren Yeager. Jean Kirstein. Marco Bott. Connie Springer. Sasha Braus. Krista Lenz.

b.speaker: keith
b.text: {name}. You missed the ten. Your file says...

c.speaker: keith
c.text: 'Doesn't quit.' Out there that counts for more than a ranking. You'll choose your branch after your first posting. Dismissed.

choices.text: (Salute.)
Sir, why did you leave the Survey Corps?

d.speaker: keith
d.text: Because I wasn't special, cadet. Most of us aren't. Now get out of my sight.

a.speaker: eren
a.text: Last day as cadets. Tomorrow I sign up for the Survey Corps. I've been waiting five years for this.

b.speaker: sasha
b.text: I took some meat from the officers' storeroom. Real meat. We can split it tonight.

choices.text: Sasha, you're going to get us all thrown in a cell.
I want a big piece.

c.text: Then the light changes. Lightning, out of a clear sky.

a.speaker: dimo_reeves
a.text: Keep pushing! Do you know what's in this cart? It's worth more than this whole street!

b.speaker: civilian_f
b.text: Please, we can't get past! They're coming!

choices.text: Move the cart. Now.
None of that's worth anything if you get eaten, Mr. Reeves.
Everyone, push with me!

c3.text: Twenty people throw their weight against it, and the cart finally scrapes through the gate.

a.speaker: armin
a.text: Our whole squad's gone. Eren... Eren got eaten. He pushed me out of its mouth.

b.speaker: armin
b.text: And there's a titan out there killing other titans. It's not attacking us at all.

choices.text: Then we use it to get to the supplies.
It's a titan, Armin. It's not on our side.
Titans don't do that. Something's off.

c.speaker: armin
c.text: Mikasa's already out there with it. We have to move.

a.speaker: mikasa
a.text: He came out of its neck. Eren. He's alive. They're going to call him a monster.

choices.text: Then they'll have to get through me first.
Mikasa... can you blame them?
If a person can turn into one... what are they?

b.speaker: mikasa
b.text: Stay close to me.

effects.deed: Saw Eren Yeager come out of a titan at Trost

a.speaker: erwin
a.text: Trost has been sealed. A titan carried the boulder into the gate, and that titan was one of our own cadets.

b.speaker: erwin
b.text: I won't pretend the Survey Corps is safe. Most of you would die within the year. But what we find out there might be the truth about this world.

c.speaker: levi
c.text: Make your choice. Don't whine about it later.

choices.text: The Survey Corps.
The Garrison. Somebody has to keep the Walls standing.
The Military Police.

d2.speaker: erwin
d2.text: The Walls will be glad of you.

d3.speaker: erwin
d3.text: The interior could use more honest soldiers. More than you'd think.
